brief:
Israeli forces constructed earthen barriers along Salah al-Din street in southern Gaza, according to the Ma'an news agency. The street serves as a major north-south artery through the territory. The barrier installation occurred as artillery shelling struck the al-Tuffah neighborhood of Gaza City, raising questions about the scope and trajectory of military operations across the Strip.

The fortifications on Salah al-Din represent a significant physical alteration to civilian movement patterns in the southern region. Military construction of this scale typically restricts civilian access and signals extended operational presence in contested areas.
title: Israel erects earthen barriers on main Gaza street amid artillery fire.
